title: Cloud Foundry Org & Space
summary: Runtime grouping for apps and service instances inside CF environment.
explain: When a Cloud Foundry environment is enabled on a subaccount, you get orgs and spaces. Spaces hold apps, routes, and service instances. Spaces are not the same as subaccounts — subaccounts are BTP isolation; spaces are CF runtime isolation.
analogy: Subaccount = building floor; CF space = a specific lab room on that floor.
whyItMatters: Deploying to the wrong space breaks routes, bindings, and least-privilege ops.
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Cloud Foundry Org & Space” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Cloud → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Landing zone setup week: apply Cloud Foundry Org & Space so Dev/Test/Prod don't share blast radius.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Cloud Foundry Org & Space” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Cloud Foundry Org & Space”.
